title: Alachua County Education: 4,339 Hispanic students were enrolled in schools in 2023-24 school year
text:
Manny Diaz, Jr. Commissioner of education at Florida Department of Education | https://www.flbog.edu/member/21325/
Manny Diaz, Jr. Commissioner of education at Florida Department of Education | https://www.flbog.edu/member/21325/
Florida Department of Education.
Data showed that Alachua County welcomed a total of 29,864 students during the 2023-24 school year. Among them, Hispanic students comprised 14.5% of the student body to be the third most represented ethnicity in the county.
Among the 57 schools in Alachua County, Gainesville High School recorded the highest enrollment of Hispanic students in the 2023-24 school year, with a total of 370 students, making up 20.7% of the school's total student body.
Gov. DeSantis has approved an education budget of over $28 billion for the 2024-25 school year. The new budget includes more than $1 billion earmarked exclusively for teacher salaries to better address the teacher shortage the state faces.
A 2024 WalletHub study ranked Florida 49th in the nation for teacher salaries when adjusted for cost of living, making it one of the lowest in the U.S.
